title: Write the mmseqs target db in parallel
body:
db write is 15.5 s on the mgy run, 3.2% of the run and the largest serial item. write_mmseqs_sequence_database (mmseqs.rs:433) iterates 2.4M records through Database::get, a seek plus read_exact per record, parses each into utf8 and digital byte vectors with a map lookup per residue, and writes through a BufWriter, all on one thread.

Fix: rayon over index ranges, each producing a byte buffer and per-record lengths, then one sequential write that assigns the offsets. Writing about 700 MB sequentially is near 1 s on an SSD, so the floor is close to that. The query db write can run beside it on another thread. Expected: 15 s to 1 or 2 s.
